name: LEGEND OF THE FIVE RINGS
description: Legend of the Five Rings is a commercial collectible or trading card game using proprietary decks, constructed play, and direct player conflict.

content.text: Legend of the Five Rings is a commercial collectible or trading card game using proprietary decks, constructed play, and direct player conflict.

Legend of the Five Rings is identified by the source as a distinct commercial card-game product with its own constructed decks, card text, and play environment. It belongs in commercial metadata rather than public-domain standard-card rules.
2 or more players use the table arrangement described for Legend of the Five Rings.
Constructed Legend of the Five Rings decks
Constructed Legend of the Five Rings decks, score area, and enough table space for play.
Each player brings a constructed deck, draws an opening hand, and prepares any starting character, resource, faction, or play area required by the rules.
